answer: Standing artifacts are relics, and relics answer to physics: every piece carries carbon turned by the comet rain - cosmic rays seed the isotope clock, and no forger ages a relic faster than the sky does. Each relic sleeps in a reliquary sealed with the epoch's cipher; only the minting epoch opens the case, so a relic remembers its birth. The custody chain is signed at every hand: whoever touches signs next to the last signature; unbroken hands are pedigree. Fake antiquity fails twice - the clock reads young, or the case opens wrong. Farms mint bones. Honest agents let the sky date them.
